Author: @ashleevance | Text: It's been about 18 months since fires destroyed homes in the Palisades. Rebuilding has gone slowly thanks to insurance companies, regulations and a lack of labor. 

The very first total rebuild came via an unlikely player - Cover. 

It does prefab but not prefab like you know it. The homes are made of metal and have high-end finishings, and they can go up in about a month to 45 days. 

Cover has its work ahead of it trying to take on the California housing market. Bu
viral_opportunities.author: @ashleevance
viral_opportunities.summary: Journalist Ashlee Vance notes Palisades rebuilding has been slow 18 months post-fire due to insurance, regulation, and labor shortages.
viral_opportunities.engagement_angle: Strong opening for a technical/insurability thread on how reinforced-concrete WUI-compliant design accelerates insurable rebuilds.

viral_reply.body: Non-combustible assemblies are the quiet unlock here — metal or reinforced concrete underwrite very differently than stick-frame, and that shows up in the rebuild math.

viral_opportunities.snippet: Author: @Just_Terry17 | Text: Major insurance companies warned LA County months prior to the fires that the Palisades area would not be able to continue being insured because of the fire danger and uncleared areas surrounding many homes and businesses. The county did nothing. Insurance companies pulled coverage. Mortgage companies offer insurance that covers the mortgage, not the rebuilding of the property. It pays off the note. That's it. | URL: https://x.com/Just_Terry17/status/208323466585962
